Sub.: Submission of audio recording of Earnings Conference Call – Q1 FY 2026-27 
 
Dear Sir/ Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, this is to inform you that the audio recording of the 
Earnings Conference Call held with the Investors and Analysts (Group Meet) today i.e.  
August 10, 2026 regarding discussion on operational and financial performance for the first quarter 
ended June 30, 2026, is available on the Company’s website and can be accessed through the link: 
 
https://ionexchangeglobal.com/app/uploads/2026/08/Concall-Ion-Exchange-India-Limited-
10082026.mp3 
 
Kindly take the information on record. 
 
Thanking You, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Ion Exchange (India) Limited 
 
 
 
Nikisha Solanki 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer 
ACS-50894 
 
NIKISHA
